channel.title: Citizen News & Media Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Citizen News & Media Limited (hackneycitizen.co.uk)

item.title: TfL Dial-a-Ride service criticised for cancelled journeys
item.description: Residents claim the service is not meeting their needs

item.title: Hackney primary school scoops up prestigious award for ‘inspiring’ music programme
item.description: Rushmore Primary School in Lower Clapton won the Outstanding School Music Department at the Music and Drama Education Awards 2026 last week

item.title: Councillor calls for ‘powers to intervene’ as review into other Mossbourne schools launched
item.description: A review of Mossbourne's schools in Thurrock is now underway following the publication of a damning report into practices at one of its Hackney academies

item.title: ‘Belter for the Shelter’ benefit night sees comedy legends raise money for Hackney charity
item.description: The comedy night will raise funds to allow homelessness charity Hackney Night Shelter to continue to provide its vital services

item.title: Mayor accused of ‘watering down’ affordable housing expectations
item.description: Sadiq Khan did not commit to meeting the goal of 17,800 affordable housing starts by next month

item.title: Met Police trialling use of handheld facial recognition technology, mayor confirms
item.description: Sadiq Khan confirmed the six-month trial, which involves around 100 devices, following questioning by Zoë Garbett

item.title: Labour assembly members accused of putting party first as they vote against budget amendments
item.description: Last week, the mayor's annual budget for 2026-27 passed without any changes despite eight formal amendments being proposed

item.title: Ridley Road Shopping Village to close following ‘ongoing antisocial behaviour’
item.description: The indoor market in Dalston will be temporarily shut from 31 March 2026

item.title: Rewilding group ‘devastated’ as Kingsland Basin ‘silenced of its birdsong’ by maintenance work
item.description: The Wildlife Gardeners of Haggerston (WGH) say their efforts to support wildlife living in and around the Basin have been thwarted after grounds maintenance workers cleared the area of vegetation

item.title: City Hall to introduce new data centre policy amid environmental concerns
item.description: The Greater London Authority's Assistant Director for Environment and Energy confirmed City Hall is developing a new policy which will attempt to balance the economic benefits and environmental damage of the data centres
